# AGENTS.md — Repository Engineering & Skill Sync Rules

`book-studio-skills` is a multi-harness Agent Skills suite (9 skills + `/book` command) supporting **OpenCode**, **Claude Code**, **OpenAI Codex CLI**, and **DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`)**.

## Canonical Source of Truth

1. **Always edit files inside `skills/<skill-name>/` first.** Never directly edit `.opencode/skills/`, `.claude/skills/`, `.agents/skills/`, or `.dsh/skills/`.
2. Keep `skills/` strictly **depth-1 flat** (`skills/<kebab-name>/SKILL.md`) so `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem` discovers every skill without nested directory drops.
3. Quote any YAML frontmatter value containing colons (`description: "..."`) so strict parsers in OpenCode and DeepSeek Harness succeed.
4. After modifying anything in `skills/`, run:
   ```bash
   ./scripts/sync-platforms.sh
   python3 scripts/validate.py
   ```
5. Every bundled Python CLI tool must support `--help`, run deterministically on both **Arabic (`RTL`)** and **English (`LTR`)** books, and pass end-to-end compilation + 15-gate preflight QC in `scripts/validate.py`.

# `book-architect` — Book Architecture, Voice Lock & Continuity Bibles

Never jump straight from a topic prompt into drafting Chapter 1. Books drafted without an explicit chapter contract, terminology lock, and Voice Lock collapse by Chapter 4 into repetitive structure, drifting terminology, and generic AI cadence.

## 1. Four-Artifact Architecture Protocol

Before `book-drafter` writes any full chapter, produce and lock four artifacts inside `editorial/`:

1. **`editorial/outline.json` — Chapter & Section Contract:**
   - Every chapter defines: `id`, `title`, `core_question`, `key_takeaway`, `opening_hook_type`, `target_words`, `sections[]`, and `planned_figures[]`.
   - Enforce **anti-overlap**: no two chapters may share the same central case study, metaphor, or thesis claim.
2. **`editorial/book-bible.md` — Continuity & Bilingual Terminology Lock:**
   - For non-fiction/technical books (especially Arabic `RTL`): lock the exact Arabic translation of every recurring technical term (e.g., `Idempotency -> التماثل التكراري`, `Latency -> زمن الاستجابة`) on first mention so Chapter 2 and Chapter 8 never use conflicting translations.
   - For fiction: lock character voices, physical traits, timeline dates, and world rules.
3. **`editorial/voice-lock.md` — 600–800 Word Calibration Sample:**
   - Write one 600–800 word calibration passage in the target register and lock rhythm rules (sentence-length burstiness `CV >= 0.40`, banned openings, pronoun stance, vocalization level for Arabic).
4. **`editorial/art-bible.md` — Visual & Diagram Cohesion Lock:**
   - Lock palette hex codes, stroke weights, diagram font family, and the **No-Text-In-Raster-Art** rule for `book-illustrator`.

See [`references/genre-blueprints.md`](references/genre-blueprints.md) for structural arcs across all 6 genres.

## 2. Deterministic CLI Usage

```bash
# Generate editorial/outline.json, voice-lock.md, book-bible.md, art-bible.md & optional chapter stubs
python3 skills/book-architect/scripts/scaffold_outline.py \
  --project ./my-book \
  --chapters 8 \
  --words-per-chapter 2500 \
  --scaffold-chapters

# Validate an edited editorial/outline.json for duplicate titles, missing theses, or budget skew
python3 skills/book-architect/scripts/scaffold_outline.py \
  --project ./my-book \
  --validate-only
```

## 3. Hard Guardrails

- **Vary Chapter Openings:** Explicitly assign distinct `opening_hook_type` tags across consecutive chapters (`incident`, `paradox`, `historical-vignette`, `metric-anomaly`, `dialogue`, `direct-thesis`) so every chapter does not open with the same formula.
- **Pause for User Approval When Interactive:** Present the outline summary and Voice Lock sample before launching full-manuscript drafting.

# `book-cover-wrap` — KDP/IngramSpark Caliper Spine & `RTL`/`LTR` Wraparound Cover Engine

Never build a print book cover from an estimated page count or apply an English (`LTR`) template to an Arabic (`RTL`) book.

## 1. Non-Negotiable Print Cover Laws

1. **Read Actual Page Count (`N`) From Final Interior PDF:**
   - `calc_and_render_cover.py` inspects `dist/interior-paperback.pdf` directly via `pikepdf`.
2. **Exact Paper Caliper Spine Formula:**
   - White (`white`): `N × 0.002252 in` (`0.0572 mm`)
   - Cream (`cream`): `N × 0.002500 in` (`0.0635 mm`)
   - Premium Color (`color-premium`): `N × 0.002347 in` (`0.0596 mm`)
   - Full width = `0.125" bleed + trim_w + spine_w + trim_w + 0.125" bleed`; Full height = `0.125" + trim_h + 0.125"`.
3. **KDP `<79` Pages Spine-Text Ban:**
   - If `N < 79`, KDP rejects ANY text or logo on the spine due to `±0.0625"` fold variance. Our engine suppresses spine text automatically whenever `N < 79`.
4. **Automatic `RTL` vs `LTR` Full-Wrap Mirroring:**
   - **English (`LTR`):** `[Bleed] [Back Cover + Barcode] [Spine] [Front Cover] [Bleed]`
   - **Arabic (`RTL`):** `[Bleed] [Front Cover] [Spine] [Back Cover + Barcode] [Bleed]` — mirrored automatically when `direction == "rtl"` so right-bound Arabic books open from the front!

See [`references/cover-geometry-specs.md`](references/cover-geometry-specs.md) for mechanical diagrams, hardcover wrap allowances, and barcode keepout coordinates.

## 2. Deterministic CLI Usage

```bash
# Read dist/interior-paperback.pdf, compute spine & mirror layout, and render proof SVG + print PDF + eBook PNG
python3 skills/book-cover-wrap/scripts/calc_and_render_cover.py \
  --project ./my-book \
  --blurb "وصف الغلاف الخلفي للكتاب..."

# Pre-interior mechanical calculator only (explicit --pages override for early planning; never use for final press!)
python3 skills/book-cover-wrap/scripts/calc_and_render_cover.py \
  --project ./my-book \
  --pages 240 \
  --spec-only
```

## 3. Generated Deliverables

- `dist/cover-spec.json` — Exact dimensions (`in`, `mm`, `pt`), `front_panel`, `spine_panel`, `back_panel`, and `barcode_keepout` coordinates.
- `dist/cover-wrap-proof.svg` — Visual proof with trim, bleed, spine fold dashed guides, and barcode box.
- `dist/cover-wrap-print.pdf` — Clean press-ready full-wrap PDF (guide lines stripped, zero annotations, exact `MediaBox`).
- `dist/cover-ebook.png` — `1600 × 2560 px` digital store thumbnail for Kindle, Apple Books, Kobo & Abjjad.

# `book-drafter` — Continuity Drafting, Claim Ledger & Humanizer Bridge

Write and refine full-length book chapters that read like an authoritative human author across 200+ pages — never like stitched-together LLM blog posts.

## 1. Full-Context Continuity Protocol

1. **Before Writing Chapter `N`:**
   - Read `editorial/outline.json`, `editorial/book-bible.md`, and `editorial/voice-lock.md`.
   - Read the closing 400 words of Chapter `N-1` plus the list of metaphors/examples already used so Chapter `N` never repeats an anecdote, opening formula, or definition.
2. **Ground Every Fact in `editorial/claims-ledger.json`:**
   - Whenever a chapter cites a date, percentage, benchmark, historical event, or research study, log `{ "id", "chapter", "claim", "numbers", "source", "verified" }` in `editorial/claims-ledger.json`. Never invent citations or statistics.

## 2. Seven-Stage Editorial Loop + `humanizer-skills` Bridge

Run every drafted chapter through 7 focused passes:
1. **Structural Arc Pass:** Does the chapter answer its `core_question` from `outline.json`?
2. **Continuity & Terminology Pass:** Check every technical/character term against `editorial/book-bible.md`.
3. **Claim & Digit Lock Pass:** Verify every statistic and footnote against `editorial/claims-ledger.json`.
4. **Line Rhythm & Burstiness Pass:** Break monotonous 15–18 word paragraphs; alternate crisp 6-word verdicts with multi-clause explanations (`CV >= 0.40`).
5. **Bilingual Anti-Slop Pass (`humanizer-skills` Integration):**
   - Strip English AI tells (`delve`, `tapestry`, `leverage`, `Moreover,`, prose em-dash overuse, `Not X, but Y` formulas).
   - Strip Arabic AI translation calques (`في ظل التطورات المتسارعة`, `مما لا شك فيه`, `يلعب دوراً محورياً`, excessive `تم + المصدر` passive calques, `يقوم بـ + المصدر` padding, and `لا يقتصر الأمر على X فحسب، بل يتعداه إلى Y`).
   - If [`humanizer-skills`](https://github.com/abduallahJamal/humanizer-skills) is installed in the harness, invoke `humanize-text` (or `academic-humanizer` for scholarly monographs) directly before locking the manuscript!
6. **Opening & Ending Surgery:** Cut throat-clearing first paragraphs and summary-style *"In conclusion, this chapter showed..."* endings.
7. **Cold Beta-Reader Gate:** Score Chapters 1–3 on Hook Strength, Clarity, Pacing, Voice Authenticity, and Put-Down Risk (`>= 7/10` on every axis before typesetting).

See [`references/editorial-and-humanizer-bridge.md`](references/editorial-and-humanizer-bridge.md) for the complete 7-stage checklist and Arabic/English slop dictionary.

## 3. Deterministic CLI Usage

```bash
# Audit manuscript word budgets, burstiness CV, cross-chapter repetition, AR/EN AI slop & claim grounding
python3 skills/book-drafter/scripts/manuscript_metrics.py --project ./my-book

# Strict gate mode (exits non-zero if high AI-slop density or cross-chapter 6-gram cloning is detected)
python3 skills/book-drafter/scripts/manuscript_metrics.py --project ./my-book --strict
```

# `book-ebook-web` — Standards-Compliant `EPUB 3` (`RTL`/`LTR` + `MathML`) & Static Web Book

Generate digital editions from the exact same `manuscript/` tree and `book.config.json` without duplicating prose.

## 1. Native Arabic `RTL` & `MathML` EPUB 3.3 Engineering

1. **Uncompressed `mimetype` First Entry:** Writes `application/epub+zip` with `ZIP_STORED` at byte offset 0 so Apple Books, Kindle Previewer, Kobo, and `epubcheck` recognize the container immediately.
2. **Arabic Right-to-Left Spine Progression:** Sets `page-progression-direction="rtl"` on `<spine>` inside `OEBPS/content.opf` and `dir="rtl" xml:lang="ar"` on every `.xhtml` document so e-readers flip pages naturally from right to left.
3. **BiDi Code & MathML Isolation:** Wraps `<pre dir="ltr">` code blocks and converts `$...$` / `$$...$$` formulas into native `MathML` (`properties="mathml"` declared in `<manifest>`).
4. **Strict XML Gate:** Every `.xhtml`, `nav.xhtml`, and `.opf` file is parsed via `ElementTree` XML validation before packaging, followed by a post-pack structural archive audit.

## 2. Multi-Page Static HTML Web Book (`dist/web-book/`)

Builds a self-contained static web edition (zero external CDNs, works offline or on GitHub Pages / Cloudflare Pages):
- Multi-page chapter navigation (`prev` / `next` + collapsible TOC sidebar)
- Instant client-side full-text search (`search-index.json`) supporting Arabic and English queries
- Reader appearance switcher (`Light`, `Sepia`, `Dark`)

See [`references/epub3-and-web-specs.md`](references/epub3-and-web-specs.md) for OPF metadata, Kindle/Abjjad BiDi CSS, and validation checks.

## 3. Deterministic CLI Usage

```bash
# Build both EPUB 3 (dist/<slug>.epub) and Static Web Book (dist/web-book/) + run structural validator
python3 skills/book-ebook-web/scripts/build_epub_and_web.py --project ./my-book

# Validate an existing .epub file for OPF/XHTML XML well-formedness, mimetype store rule & RTL spine
python3 skills/book-ebook-web/scripts/build_epub_and_web.py --project ./my-book --validate-only
```

# `book-illustrator` — Print-Safe Vector Diagrams, Chapter Openers & Asset Hygiene

Bad book graphics break print builds silently: Mermaid `<foreignObject>` labels disappear inside Typst/LaTeX PDFs, 72-DPI web screenshots print blurry on paper, and AI-generated raster art mangles Arabic or English lettering.

## 1. Two-Tier Visual Routing Policy

1. **Tier A — Technical Diagrams, Pipelines & Data Charts (Pure Vector `SVG`):**
   - Author diagrams as pure `<svg>` with explicit `viewBox`, `<rect>`, `<path>`, and native `<text>` elements — **never `<foreignObject>` HTML wrappers** and never remote `http://` linked stylesheets or fonts.
   - Match stroke colors and accents to `editorial/art-bible.md` (high-contrast grayscale-safe for `ink: "bw"` interiors!).
2. **Tier B — Chapter Openers & Spot Illustrations (`PNG` >= 300 DPI):**
   - **Strict No-Text Rule:** Raster art prompts must specify *"pure visual illustration, zero letters, zero words, zero numbers, zero watermarks"*. Titles and captions belong in Typst/CSS typography, never baked into pixels.
   - **Chroma-Key Transparency:** Strip solid white/green studio backgrounds (`--chroma-key`) so line-art vignettes sit cleanly on both screen cream and print white pages.
   - **Snapshot-Diff Guard:** Record every figure's SHA-256 digest in `assets/figures/figures-manifest.json` so failed image generations never silently reuse a previous chapter's PNG.

See [`references/visual-routing-rules.md`](references/visual-routing-rules.md) for DPI math, B&W halftone safety, and SVG rules.

## 2. Deterministic CLI Usage

```bash
# Audit all SVGs & PNGs in assets/figures/ (bans <foreignObject>, checks >= 300 DPI at trim width, writes manifest)
python3 skills/book-illustrator/scripts/prepare_figures.py --project ./my-book

# Render a print-safe pure-SVG pipeline diagram from a declarative JSON spec (zero <foreignObject>)
python3 skills/book-illustrator/scripts/prepare_figures.py \
  --project ./my-book \
  --render-pipeline-svg ./assets/figures/pipeline.spec.json \
  --out ./assets/figures/fig-01-pipeline.svg

# Strip solid white/near-white background from a chapter-opener PNG using Pillow chroma-key
python3 skills/book-illustrator/scripts/prepare_figures.py \
  --project ./my-book \
  --chroma-key ./assets/figures/opener-raw.png \
  --out ./assets/figures/opener-clean.png
```

# `book-intake` — Manuscript Intake, Normalization & Content Lock

Turn messy real-world manuscripts (`.docx`, `.pdf`, or scattered `.md`/`.txt` drafts) into a clean, single-source `manuscript/` tree **without altering a single word of the author's prose**.

## 1. Core Responsibilities

1. **Structural Splitting:** Split monolithic manuscripts on top-level chapter headings (`Heading 1` / `# `) into `manuscript/chapters/ch-01.md`, `ch-02.md`, etc., routing frontmatter (`Preface`, `Foreword`, `مقدمة`, `إهداء`) to `manuscript/frontmatter/`.
2. **Footnote & Table Preservation:** Extract Word `word/footnotes.xml` entries into standard Markdown `[^1]` footnotes, convert `.docx` tables into pipe tables, and export embedded media (`word/media/*`) into `assets/figures/` with lifted alt-text captions.
3. **Ligature & BiDi Normalization:** Repair broken PDF extraction ligatures (`ﬁ` -> `fi`, `ﬂ` -> `fl`) and normalize Arabic presentation forms (`U+FB50–U+FDFF`, `U+FE70–U+FEFF`) to canonical UTF-8 codepoints (`NFKC`).
4. **Content-Integrity Fingerprint Lock (`manuscript.lock.json`):** Record exact character-skeleton multisets, numeric token inventories (`0-9` and `٠-٩`), table counts, and chapter word counts so `book-typesetter` and `book-preflight-qc` (`G14`) halt immediately if formatting ever drops a paragraph, number, or table cell.

See [`references/intake-normalization-rules.md`](references/intake-normalization-rules.md) for ligature, footnote, and Arabic Unicode normalization rules.

## 2. Deterministic CLI Usage

```bash
# Import a Word (.docx), PDF (.pdf), or single/folder Markdown manuscript into a Book Studio project
python3 skills/book-intake/scripts/import_manuscript.py \
  --source ./raw-draft.docx \
  --project ./my-book

# Lock or refresh manuscript.lock.json on an already-organized manuscript/ folder
python3 skills/book-intake/scripts/import_manuscript.py \
  --project ./my-book \
  --lock-only
```

## 3. Hard Guardrails

- **Zero Silent Editing:** Intake normalizes structure and Unicode encoding only. Never rewrite prose, "fix" style, or summarize during `book-intake` — prose editing belongs strictly to `book-drafter` or `humanizer-skills`.
- **Inspect Image DPI Early:** After extracting embedded `.docx`/`.pdf` images into `assets/figures/`, run `book-illustrator`'s `prepare_figures.py` before print typesetting to flag sub-300 DPI graphics.

# `book-preflight-qc` — Safe `PDF/X-1a` Press Prep & 15 Physical Geometry Gates

Never trust a PDF just because the compiler exited with code `0`. No file enters `dist/press-ready/` until it passes `press_pdfx.py` and all **15 physical gates** in `preflight_qc.py`.

## 1. The Ghostscript `PDF/X-1a` Annotation Trap (`press_pdfx.py`)

If a PDF contains even one `/Link` annotation from a Table of Contents or cross-reference, Ghostscript (`gs -dPDFX`) prints a quiet warning (`reverting to normal PDF output`) and drops `PDF/X-1a` compliance while still exiting `0`!
- **`press_pdfx.py` Sequence:**
  1. Open PDF with `pikepdf` and delete all `/Annots` across every page **before** Ghostscript runs.
  2. Normalize `MediaBox`, `BleedBox`, and `TrimBox` to `0.01pt` accuracy and attach `GTS_PDFX` `/OutputIntents` metadata.
  3. When Ghostscript (`gs`) is installed and `--cmyk` is passed, convert color space to `DeviceCMYK` and re-apply `TrimBox` via `pikepdf`.

## 2. The 15 Physical Preflight Gates (`preflight_qc.py`)

| Gate | Physical Check | Engine |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `G01` | Exact `MediaBox` / `TrimBox` dimensions (`±0.5pt`) on interior & cover | `pikepdf` |
| `G02` | Even page count & `>= min_pages` (`24pp` KDP floor) | `pikepdf` |
| `G03` | 100% embedded font subsets & **zero `Type3` fallback bitmap fonts** | `PyMuPDF` |
| `G04` | **Zero interactive `/Annots`** on print interior & wrap cover | `pikepdf` |
| `G05` | `/TrimBox` + `/OutputIntents` (`GTS_PDFX`) press dictionary present | `pikepdf` |
| `G06` | Safe-margin overflow scan across all text & table bounding boxes | `PyMuPDF` |
| `G07` | Vertical line `y`-collision detector (catches stacked table rows) | `PyMuPDF` |
| `G08` | Bottom-of-page orphan heading detector | `PyMuPDF` |
| `G09` | Printed Table of Contents folio sync vs actual chapter pages | `PyMuPDF` |
| `G10` | Embedded raster image effective resolution `>= 300 DPI` | `PyMuPDF` |
| `G11` | B&W interior screen-tint guard (blocks full-page `#FAF8F5` gray halftone) | `PyMuPDF` |
| `G12` | Callout / stat box numeric grounding against chapter prose & ledger | Python |
| `G13` | Cover RTL/LTR side check, `<79pp` empty-spine verification & barcode keepout | `PyMuPDF` |
| `G14` | BiDi-aware Content-Integrity Fingerprint parity vs `manuscript.lock.json` | `PyMuPDF` |
| `G15` | High-resolution `contact-sheet-interior.png` & `contact-sheet-cover.png` | `Pillow` |

See [`references/preflight-15-gates.md`](references/preflight-15-gates.md) for failure diagnostics and exact fixes for each gate.

## 3. Deterministic CLI Usage

```bash
# 1. Strip annotations, normalize TrimBox/BleedBox, tag GTS_PDFX OutputIntent (+ optional Ghostscript CMYK)
python3 skills/book-preflight-qc/scripts/press_pdfx.py --project ./my-book --cmyk

# 2. Run all 15 physical gates, render PNG contact sheets & promote verified files to dist/press-ready/
python3 skills/book-preflight-qc/scripts/preflight_qc.py --project ./my-book
```

# `book-typesetter` — Tri-Engine Bilingual Book Typesetter (`AR RTL` & `EN LTR`)

Compile a single `manuscript/` tree + `book.config.json` into press-accurate **Paperback**, **Hardcover**, **Large-Print (`16pt`)**, and **Screen** interiors using **Typst** (primary sub-second PDF engine), **HTML/CSS Paged Media**, and **LaTeX/Quarto**, while mathematically verifying that zero words, numbers, or table cells were lost.

## 1. Tri-Engine Architecture

| Engine | Flag | Output Artifacts | Best For |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Typst (Primary)** | `--engine typst` | `dist/interior-{paperback,hardcover,large-print,screen}.pdf` + `.typ` source | Sub-second compilation, native HarfBuzz Arabic `RTL`, math, multi-page tables |
| **HTML/CSS Paged Media** | `--engine html` | `dist/html-paged/book-paged.html` + `paged-print.css` (+ PDF if Chromium installed) | Magazine-like visual spreads, custom CSS grids, Paged.js workflows |
| **LaTeX / Quarto** | `--engine quarto` | `dist/quarto-latex/_quarto.yml` + `preamble.tex` + `.qmd` chapters (+ PDF if Quarto/LuaLaTeX installed) | University press monographs, heavy BibTeX/theorem environments |

See [`references/tri-engine-typography.md`](references/tri-engine-typography.md) for mirrored gutters, Arabic BiDi isolation, multi-page table safety, and screen-vs-print separation.

## 2. Six Bilingual Style Packs (`assets/themes/style_packs.json`)

- `trade-nonfiction` — Crisp contemporary chapter numbers, balanced margins, clean callout sidebars.
- `literary-novel` — Classic book rhythm, warm paragraph indents, ornamental scene breaks (`⁂`), minimal running headers.
- `technical-code` — Isolated `LTR` syntax blocks inside `RTL` or `LTR` prose, repeating multi-page table headers, figure frames.
- `academic-monograph` — Numbered section hierarchy (`1.1`), dense footnotes, formal running headers, equation support.
- `executive-report` — High-contrast tables, KPI callouts, generous outer margins.
- `classic-arabic-turath` — Traditional Arabic book craft (`الكتاب العربي التراثي والأدبي`), generous `leading` for full/partial vocalization (`التشكيل`), ornamental chapter frames.

## 3. Deterministic CLI Usage

```bash
# Compile all configured print + screen editions across all 3 engines + verify Content Fingerprint
python3 skills/book-typesetter/scripts/build_interior.py \
  --project ./my-book \
  --engine all \
  --edition all

# Fast Typst-only Paperback + Screen build during iterative layout tuning
python3 skills/book-typesetter/scripts/build_interior.py \
  --project ./my-book \
  --engine typst \
  --edition paperback screen
```

## 4. Built-In Print Safeguards

1. **Print vs Screen Separation:** Print editions (`paperback`, `hardcover`, `large-print`) strip all screen paper tints (pure white background so B&W KDP presses never halftone!) and strip interactive PDF `/Link` annotations via `pikepdf`.
2. **Multi-Page Table Safety:** Every pipe table compiles inside `block(breakable: true)` with a repeating `table.header(...)` so 150-row tables never stack on a single `y`-coordinate.
3. **Sticky Headings:** Every heading sets `sticky: true` to prevent orphan headings at page bottoms (`G08`).
4. **Even-Page Lock & Manifest:** Pads flyleaves to guarantee an even page count (`>= min_pages`) and writes `dist/interior-manifest.json` with the **actual PDF page count** required by `book-cover-wrap`.

# `book` — Master Book Studio Orchestrator (`/book`)

You are the chief publishing engineer for `book-studio-skills`. Route every user book request to the right specialist skill while enforcing **non-negotiable physical print dependencies**.

## 1. Non-Negotiable Cross-Bench Dependency Law

Never violate physical print causality:

```text
book.config.json (trim + language + direction + style_pack)
   ├─► Path A (Existing .docx/.pdf/.md) ──► book-intake (manuscript/ + manuscript.lock.json)
   └─► Path B (Topic / Raw Idea) ─────────► book-architect ──► book-drafter (+ humanizer-skills)
```

# `book-cover-wrap` — KDP/IngramSpark Caliper Spine & `RTL`/`LTR` Wraparound Cover Engine

Never build a print book cover from an estimated page count or apply an English (`LTR`) template to an Arabic (`RTL`) book.

## 1. Non-Negotiable Print Cover Laws

1. **Read Actual Page Count (`N`) From Final Interior PDF:**
   - `calc_and_render_cover.py` inspects `dist/interior-paperback.pdf` directly via `pikepdf`.
2. **Exact Paper Caliper Spine Formula:**
   - White (`white`): `N × 0.002252 in` (`0.0572 mm`)
   - Cream (`cream`): `N × 0.002500 in` (`0.0635 mm`)
   - Premium Color (`color-premium`): `N × 0.002347 in` (`0.0596 mm`)
   - Full width = `0.125" bleed + trim_w + spine_w + trim_w + 0.125" bleed`; Full height = `0.125" + trim_h + 0.125"`.
3. **KDP `<79` Pages Spine-Text Ban:**
   - If `N < 79`, KDP rejects ANY text or logo on the spine due to `±0.0625"` fold variance. Our engine suppresses spine text automatically whenever `N < 79`.
4. **Automatic `RTL` vs `LTR` Full-Wrap Mirroring:**
   - **English (`LTR`):** `[Bleed] [Back Cover + Barcode] [Spine] [Front Cover] [Bleed]`
   - **Arabic (`RTL`):** `[Bleed] [Front Cover] [Spine] [Back Cover + Barcode] [Bleed]` — mirrored automatically when `direction == "rtl"` so right-bound Arabic books open from the front!

See [`references/cover-geometry-specs.md`](references/cover-geometry-specs.md) for mechanical diagrams, hardcover wrap allowances, and barcode keepout coordinates.

# `book-preflight-qc` — Safe `PDF/X-1a` Press Prep & 15 Physical Geometry Gates

Never trust a PDF just because the compiler exited with code `0`. No file enters `dist/press-ready/` until it passes `press_pdfx.py` and all **15 physical gates** in `preflight_qc.py`.

## 1. The Ghostscript `PDF/X-1a` Annotation Trap (`press_pdfx.py`)

If a PDF contains even one `/Link` annotation from a Table of Contents or cross-reference, Ghostscript (`gs -dPDFX`) prints a quiet warning (`reverting to normal PDF output`) and drops `PDF/X-1a` compliance while still exiting `0`!
- **`press_pdfx.py` Sequence:**
  1. Open PDF with `pikepdf` and delete all `/Annots` across every page **before** Ghostscript runs.
  2. Normalize `MediaBox`, `BleedBox`, and `TrimBox` to `0.01pt` accuracy and attach `GTS_PDFX` `/OutputIntents` metadata.
  3. When Ghostscript (`gs`) is installed and `--cmyk` is passed, convert color space to `DeviceCMYK` and re-apply `TrimBox` via `pikepdf`.

## 2. The 15 Physical Preflight Gates (`preflight_qc.py`)

| Gate | Physical Check | Engine |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `G01` | Exact `MediaBox` / `TrimBox` dimensions (`±0.5pt`) on interior & cover | `pikepdf` |
| `G02` | Even page count & `>= min_pages` (`24pp` KDP floor) | `pikepdf` |
| `G03` | 100% embedded font subsets & **zero `Type3` fallback bitmap fonts** | `PyMuPDF` |
| `G04` | **Zero interactive `/Annots`** on print interior & wrap cover | `pikepdf` |
| `G05` | `/TrimBox` + `/OutputIntents` (`GTS_PDFX`) press dictionary present | `pikepdf` |
| `G06` | Safe-margin overflow scan across all text & table bounding boxes | `PyMuPDF` |
| `G07` | Vertical line `y`-collision detector (catches stacked table rows) | `PyMuPDF` |
| `G08` | Bottom-of-page orphan heading detector | `PyMuPDF` |
| `G09` | Printed Table of Contents folio sync vs actual chapter pages | `PyMuPDF` |
| `G10` | Embedded raster image effective resolution `>= 300 DPI` | `PyMuPDF` |
| `G11` | B&W interior screen-tint guard (blocks full-page `#FAF8F5` gray halftone) | `PyMuPDF` |
| `G12` | Callout / stat box numeric grounding against chapter prose & ledger | Python |
| `G13` | Cover RTL/LTR side check, `<79pp` empty-spine verification & barcode keepout | `PyMuPDF` |
| `G14` | BiDi-aware Content-Integrity Fingerprint parity vs `manuscript.lock.json` | `PyMuPDF` |
| `G15` | High-resolution `contact-sheet-interior.png` & `contact-sheet-cover.png` | `Pillow` |

# `book-preflight-qc` — Safe `PDF/X-1a` Press Prep & 15 Physical Geometry Gates

Never trust a PDF just because the compiler exited with code `0`. No file enters `dist/press-ready/` until it passes `press_pdfx.py` and all **15 physical gates** in `preflight_qc.py`.

## 1. The Ghostscript `PDF/X-1a` Annotation Trap (`press_pdfx.py`)

If a PDF contains even one `/Link` annotation from a Table of Contents or cross-reference, Ghostscript (`gs -dPDFX`) prints a quiet warning (`reverting to normal PDF output`) and drops `PDF/X-1a` compliance while still exiting `0`!
- **`press_pdfx.py` Sequence:**
  1. Open PDF with `pikepdf` and delete all `/Annots` across every page **before** Ghostscript runs.
  2. Normalize `MediaBox`, `BleedBox`, and `TrimBox` to `0.01pt` accuracy and attach `GTS_PDFX` `/OutputIntents` metadata.
  3. When Ghostscript (`gs`) is installed and `--cmyk` is passed, convert color space to `DeviceCMYK` and re-apply `TrimBox` via `pikepdf`.

## 2. The 15 Physical Preflight Gates (`preflight_qc.py`)

| Gate | Physical Check | Engine |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `G01` | Exact `MediaBox` / `TrimBox` dimensions (`±0.5pt`) on interior & cover | `pikepdf` |
| `G02` | Even page count & `>= min_pages` (`24pp` KDP floor) | `pikepdf` |

# `book-preflight-qc` — Safe `PDF/X-1a` Press Prep & 15 Physical Geometry Gates

Never trust a PDF just because the compiler exited with code `0`. No file enters `dist/press-ready/` until it passes `press_pdfx.py` and all **15 physical gates** in `preflight_qc.py`.

## 1. The Ghostscript `PDF/X-1a` Annotation Trap (`press_pdfx.py`)

If a PDF contains even one `/Link` annotation from a Table of Contents or cross-reference, Ghostscript (`gs -dPDFX`) prints a quiet warning (`reverting to normal PDF output`) and drops `PDF/X-1a` compliance while still exiting `0`!
- **`press_pdfx.py` Sequence:**
  1. Open PDF with `pikepdf` and delete all `/Annots` across every page **before** Ghostscript runs.
  2. Normalize `MediaBox`, `BleedBox`, and `TrimBox` to `0.01pt` accuracy and attach `GTS_PDFX` `/OutputIntents` metadata.
  3. When Ghostscript (`gs`) is installed and `--cmyk` is passed, convert color space to `DeviceCMYK` and re-apply `TrimBox` via `pikepdf`.

## 2. The 15 Physical Preflight Gates (`preflight_qc.py`)

| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `G01` | Exact `MediaBox` / `TrimBox` dimensions (`±0.5pt`) on interior & cover | `pikepdf` |
| `G02` | Even page count & `>= min_pages` (`24pp` KDP floor) | `pikepdf` |
| `G03` | 100% embedded font subsets & **zero `Type3` fallback bitmap fonts** | `PyMuPDF` |
| `G04` | **Zero interactive `/Annots`** on print interior & wrap cover | `pikepdf` |

# Tri-Engine Typography, Arabic RTL Print Rules & Anti-Collision Engineering

## 1. Inside Gutter & Recto/Verso Mirroring (`RTL` vs `LTR`)

- **Binding Margin (`inside`) > Outer Margin (`outside`):** Glued perfect-bound spines consume `0.125"–0.20"` of visual gutter. Never set symmetrical left/right margins on a printed book!
  - `Paperback`: `inside = 0.85 in`, `outside = 0.65 in`
  - `Hardcover` (case-laminate hinge): `inside = 0.95 in`, `outside = 0.70 in`
  - `Large-Print (16pt)`: `16pt` body text, `inside = 0.85 in`, `outside = 0.65 in`, wider `leading` for low-vision accessibility.
- **Arabic (`RTL`) Spread Physics:**
  - Odd pages (`1, 3, 5` — chapter `recto` openings) lie on the **left** side of an open Arabic book; their `inside` binding gutter is on the **right** edge of the page.
  - Even pages (`2, 4, 6` — `verso`) lie on the **right** side of an open Arabic book; their `inside` binding gutter is on the **left** edge.
  - Typst's `#set page(margin: (inside: ..., outside: ...))` paired with `#set text(dir: rtl)` handles this mirroring natively.

## 2. BiDi Code, Math & Identifier Isolation Inside Arabic Prose

When an Arabic paragraph embeds Python code, CLI flags (`--strict`), or equations, naive RTL layout reverses brackets, operators, and indentation:
- Every fenced code block renders inside `#block(dir: ltr)[#set text(dir: ltr, lang: "en", font: mono_font) ...]` (Typst), `<pre dir="ltr">` (HTML/EPUB), and `\begin{english}...\end{english}` (LuaLaTeX).
- Inline code spans (` `code` `) wrap in `LTR` directional isolates.

## 3. Preventing the 4 Classic Automated Typesetting Failures

1. **150-Row Table Vertical Collision (`gongnyang/bookforge`):** Unbreakable table containers overflow a page and collapse rows on top of one another. Always wrap tables in `breakable: true` with `table.header(...)`.
2. **B&W Halftone Mud (`felipefontoura/book-kit`):** Never leave a `#FAF8F5` cream fill on a `--print` PDF; KDP's black-only laser press converts `#FAF8F5` into a speckled gray dot screen over every page. Print cream comes from choosing `"paper_stock": "cream"`, not tinting the PDF!
3. **Orphan Headings (`G08`):** Apply `sticky: true` (Typst) / `break-after: avoid` (CSS) / `\needspace{4\baselineskip}` (LaTeX) to all headings.
4. **Silent Word Loss (`paper_format_agent`):** Always compare post-compile PDF extracted text & numeric inventory against `manuscript.lock.json`.

# Tri-Engine Typography, Arabic RTL Print Rules & Anti-Collision Engineering

## 1. Inside Gutter & Recto/Verso Mirroring (`RTL` vs `LTR`)

- **Binding Margin (`inside`) > Outer Margin (`outside`):** Glued perfect-bound spines consume `0.125"–0.20"` of visual gutter. Never set symmetrical left/right margins on a printed book!
  - `Paperback`: `inside = 0.85 in`, `outside = 0.65 in`
  - `Hardcover` (case-laminate hinge): `inside = 0.95 in`, `outside = 0.70 in`
  - `Large-Print (16pt)`: `16pt` body text, `inside = 0.85 in`, `outside = 0.65 in`, wider `leading` for low-vision accessibility.
- **Arabic (`RTL`) Spread Physics:**
  - Odd pages (`1, 3, 5` — chapter `recto` openings) lie on the **left** side of an open Arabic book; their `inside` binding gutter is on the **right** edge of the page.
  - Even pages (`2, 4, 6` — `verso`) lie on the **right** side of an open Arabic book; their `inside` binding gutter is on the **left** edge.
  - Typst's `#set page(margin: (inside: ..., outside: ...))` paired with `#set text(dir: rtl)` handles this mirroring natively.

## 2. BiDi Code, Math & Identifier Isolation Inside Arabic Prose

When an Arabic paragraph embeds Python code, CLI flags (`--strict`), or equations, naive RTL layout reverses brackets, operators, and indentation:
- Every fenced code block renders inside `#block(dir: ltr)[#set text(dir: ltr, lang: "en", font: mono_font) ...]` (Typst), `<pre dir="ltr">` (HTML/EPUB), and `\begin{english}...\end{english}` (LuaLaTeX).
- Inline code spans (` `code` `) wrap in `LTR` directional isolates.

## 3. Preventing the 4 Classic Automated Typesetting Failures

1. **150-Row Table Vertical Collision (`gongnyang/bookforge`):** Unbreakable table containers overflow a page and collapse rows on top of one another. Always wrap tables in `breakable: true` with `table.header(...)`.

3. **Orphan Headings (`G08`):** Apply `sticky: true` (Typst) / `break-after: avoid` (CSS) / `\needspace{4\baselineskip}` (LaTeX) to all headings.

# Tri-Engine Typography, Arabic RTL Print Rules & Anti-Collision Engineering

## 1. Inside Gutter & Recto/Verso Mirroring (`RTL` vs `LTR`)

- **Binding Margin (`inside`) > Outer Margin (`outside`):** Glued perfect-bound spines consume `0.125"–0.20"` of visual gutter. Never set symmetrical left/right margins on a printed book!
  - `Paperback`: `inside = 0.85 in`, `outside = 0.65 in`
  - `Hardcover` (case-laminate hinge): `inside = 0.95 in`, `outside = 0.70 in`
  - `Large-Print (16pt)`: `16pt` body text, `inside = 0.85 in`, `outside = 0.65 in`, wider `leading` for low-vision accessibility.
- **Arabic (`RTL`) Spread Physics:**
  - Odd pages (`1, 3, 5` — chapter `recto` openings) lie on the **left** side of an open Arabic book; their `inside` binding gutter is on the **right** edge of the page.
  - Even pages (`2, 4, 6` — `verso`) lie on the **right** side of an open Arabic book; their `inside` binding gutter is on the **left** edge.
  - Typst's `#set page(margin: (inside: ..., outside: ...))` paired with `#set text(dir: rtl)` handles this mirroring natively.

## 2. BiDi Code, Math & Identifier Isolation Inside Arabic Prose

When an Arabic paragraph embeds Python code, CLI flags (`--strict`), or equations, naive RTL layout reverses brackets, operators, and indentation:
- Every fenced code block renders inside `#block(dir: ltr)[#set text(dir: ltr, lang: "en", font: mono_font) ...]` (Typst), `<pre dir="ltr">` (HTML/EPUB), and `\begin{english}...\end{english}` (LuaLaTeX).

## 3. Preventing the 4 Classic Automated Typesetting Failures

1. **150-Row Table Vertical Collision (`gongnyang/bookforge`):** Unbreakable table containers overflow a page and collapse rows on top of one another. Always wrap tables in `breakable: true` with `table.header(...)`.

3. **Orphan Headings (`G08`):** Apply `sticky: true` (Typst) / `break-after: avoid` (CSS) / `\needspace{4\baselineskip}` (LaTeX) to all headings.

- **Outer Live Safe Margin:** Keep all text at least `0.25 in` (`6.35 mm`) inside the trim line (`0.375 in` from outer bleed edge).

# Print Wraparound Cover Geometry (`LTR` vs `RTL`)

## 1. Panel Coordinate Formulas (`Paperback` with `0.125"` Bleed)

Let:
- $W_t, H_t$ = Trim width and height in inches
- $B = 0.125\text{ in}$ (`3.175 mm`) = Outer bleed on top, bottom, left, and right
- $N$ = Actual even page count of `dist/interior-paperback.pdf`
- $C$ = Paper stock caliper (`0.002252"` white, `0.002500"` cream, `0.002347"` premium color)
- $S = N \times C$ = Spine width in inches

Then:
- $\text{Total Width } W_{\text{full}} = 2B + 2W_t + S$
- $\text{Total Height } H_{\text{full}} = 2B + H_t$

### English / Latin (`direction: "ltr"`)
```text
|<-- B -->|<------ Wt (Back Cover) ------>|<-- S -->|<------ Wt (Front Cover) ----->|<-- B -->|
|         |   [blurb]                     |  SPINE  |         BOOK TITLE            |         |
|         |              [Barcode 2x1.2"] |         |         Author Name           |         |
```

### Arabic / Right-to-Left (`direction: "rtl"`)
```text
|<-- B -->|<----- Wt (Front Cover) ------>|<-- S -->|<------ Wt (Back Cover) ------>|<-- B -->|

|         |          اسم المؤلف           |         | [Barcode 2x1.2"]              |         |
```

## 2. Safe Zones & Barcode Keepout

- **Outer Live Safe Margin:** Keep all text at least `0.25 in` (`6.35 mm`) inside the trim line (`0.375 in` from outer bleed edge).
- **Spine Hinge Safe Margin:** Keep front/back cover text at least `0.25 in` away from spine fold lines; keep spine lettering (when $N \ge 79$) at least `0.0625 in` (`1.6 mm`) inside both spine folds.
- **ISBN Barcode Keepout (`2.0 in × 1.2 in`):** Positioned in the bottom zone of the Back Cover (`>= 0.25 in` above bottom trim and `>= 0.25 in` away from spine hinge and outer trim). Must contain solid light fill and **zero overlapping cover text**.

# EPUB 3.3 (`RTL`/`LTR`) & Static Web Book Specifications

## 1. Critical EPUB 3 Packaging Rules

1. **Archive Entry #0 (`mimetype`):** Must be the very first entry in the ZIP container, stored uncompressed (`ZIP_STORED`), with exact ASCII payload `application/epub+zip` (20 bytes, no trailing newline).
2. **`META-INF/container.xml`:** Points to `OEBPS/content.opf`.
3. **`OEBPS/content.opf` (`version="3.0"`):**
   - Required Dublin Core tags: `dc:identifier`, `dc:title`, `dc:language`, `dc:creator`, plus `<meta property="dcterms:modified">YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ</meta>`.
   - Arabic books MUST set `<spine page-progression-direction="rtl">`; omitting this forces Arabic readers to swipe backward on Kindle, Kobo, and Apple Books.
   - Any XHTML document containing `<math>` MUST declare `properties="mathml"` on its `<item>` in `<manifest>`, and `OEBPS/nav.xhtml` MUST declare `properties="nav"`.
   - Any XHTML document referencing inline `<svg>` or `.svg` images works cleanly across modern EPUB 3 engines.

## 2. Reflowable E-Reader CSS Guardrails

- Never hardcode fixed `px` widths or `color: #000000; background: #FFFFFF` on `body` in EPUB CSS — doing so breaks Dark/Night mode in Kindle and Apple Books! Use relative `em`/`rem` units and inherit foreground text colors.
- Isolate code blocks with `direction: ltr; text-align: left; unicode-bidi: embed;` so brackets and operators inside Arabic books render accurately.

# Manuscript Intake & Normalization Rules

## 1. Heading Hierarchy Repair

Authors frequently style headings manually in Word using bold `16pt` text or jump from `Heading 1` straight to `Heading 4`.
- Map chapter titles strictly to `# Chapter Title` (`H1`, one per chapter file).
- Normalize internal hierarchy sequentially (`##` -> `###` -> `####`) with no skipped heading levels (required for valid EPUB 3 `<nav epub:type="toc">` accessibility).

## 2. Word `.docx` Footnotes, Alt-Text & Tables

- Extract `word/footnotes.xml` footnote IDs (`w:id >= 1`, skipping separator IDs `0` and `-1`) and emit inline `[^n]` markers at exact run positions with `[^n]: ...` definitions at chapter end.
- Lift `wp:docPr[@descr]` alt-text attributes as figure captions (`![Caption](../../assets/figures/fig-01.png)`).
- Convert every `w:tbl` into a clean Markdown pipe table so `book-typesetter` renders native repeating `table.header` multi-page tables.

## 3. Legacy PDF & Arabic Unicode Normalization

- Normalize Latin typographic ligatures (`ﬁ` `U+FB01`, `ﬂ` `U+FB02`, `ﬀ` `U+FB00`, `ﬃ` `U+FB03`, `ﬄ` `U+FB04`) via `unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", text)`.
- Normalize Arabic Presentation Forms-A/B (`U+FB50–U+FDFF`, `U+FE70–U+FEFF`, such as isolated/final `ﻻ`/`ﻷ` glyph codepoints) into standard logical Arabic sequence (`ل` + `ا` / `أ`) so HarfBuzz inside Typst and EPUB readers shapes glyphs cleanly in any font.
- Strip stray `U+00AD` soft hyphens and zero-width space artifacts left behind by PDF copy/paste.

## 4. Content-Integrity Fingerprint (`manuscript.lock.json`)

Inspired by `paper_format_agent` and `cdeistopened/book-studio`:
- Computes a BiDi-resilient **Base Letter & Digit Skeleton** (stripping Markdown syntax, Tatweel `ـ`, and optional vocalization while preserving every base Arabic/Latin letter and every Western `0-9` / Eastern Arabic `٠-٩` digit).
- Records per-chapter word counts, total numeric tokens, and character-frequency digest so downstream PDF verification (`G14`) detects even a 0.1% text truncation or missing table row without false positives from Arabic Lam-Alef shaping or line-wrap hyphenation.

- **`G01` (Trim/Bleed Mismatch):** Re-run `build_interior.py` and `calc_and_render_cover.py` so both read the identical `print.trim` and `print.bleed_in` from `book.config.json`.
- **`G02` (Odd or Short Page Count):** Print books bind 2 pages per leaf (`recto` + `verso`). `build_interior.py` pads flyleaves automatically to an even count `>= min_pages`.
- **`G03` (Unembedded or `Type3` Font):** Occurs when a missing glyph falls back to a bitmap font or Matplotlib/LaTeX emits `Type3` paths. Install proper OpenType/TrueType fonts (`fonts-amiri`, `fonts-noto-core`) and check with `doctor.py`.
- **`G04` (Interactive `/Annots` Present):** Run `press_pdfx.py` before Ghostscript/upload to strip `/Link` annotations.
- **`G05` (Missing `/TrimBox` or `/OutputIntents`):** Run `press_pdfx.py` to normalize boxes and attach `GTS_PDFX` OutputIntent dictionary.
- **`G06` (Safe-Margin Overflow):** A long unbreakable URL, wide code line, or fixed-width table spilled into the trim margin. Wrap long code lines (`<= 78` chars) or allow table column wrapping (`1fr`).
- **`G07` (Vertical Line `y`-Collision):** Caused by unbreakable multi-page containers or negative `v()` spacing. Wrap tables in `block(breakable: true)`.
- **`G08` (Orphan Heading at Page Bottom):** Ensure headings carry `sticky: true` in Typst or `break-after: avoid` in CSS.
- **`G09` (TOC Folio Desync):** Recompile from scratch rather than concatenating external cover/frontmatter PDFs ahead of the interior PDF.
- **`G10` (`< 300` Effective DPI):** Replace low-res raster PNG/JPG with pure SVG vector art or upscale/re-export at `>= 1500 px` width.
- **`G11` (Screen Tint on B&W Interior):** Never pass `--edition screen` to a print upload; use `interior-paperback.pdf` (pure white canvas).
- **`G12` (Ungrounded Callout Number):** Every KPI/percentage highlighted in a `>` callout box must appear in the chapter body or `editorial/claims-ledger.json`.
- **`G13` (Cover Spine `<79pp` Text or Barcode Overlap):** Re-run `calc_and_render_cover.py` after final interior compilation; shorten back-cover blurb if it approaches the `2.0" × 1.2"` barcode keepout box.
- **`G14` (Content-Integrity Fingerprint Mismatch):** Refresh `manuscript.lock.json` (`import_manuscript.py --lock-only`) if you intentionally edited the manuscript, or inspect truncated syntax if words/numbers were dropped during compilation.
- **`G15` (Visual Contact Sheet):** Inspect `dist/qc/contact-sheet-interior.png` and `dist/qc/contact-sheet-cover.png` visually as the final human/vision-model sign-off.

# مسرد المصطلحات التقنية

- **النظام الوكيلي (`Agentic System`):** برنامج يستخدم نموذجاً لغوياً لاختيار الأدوات وتنسيق الخطوات ضمن قيود محددة لتحقيق هدف معين.
- **بوابة التحقق الحتمية (`Deterministic Gate`):** فحص برمجي صارم يقبل المخرج أو يرفضه استناداً إلى قواعد رياضية ومنطقية ثابتة لا تقبل التخمين.
- **التماثل التكراري (`Idempotency`):** خاصية تضمن أن تنفيذ الطلب نفسه أكثر من مرة ينتج الأثر النهائي ذاته دون مضاعفة العمليات.
- **المئين الخامس والتسعون (`p95 Latency`):** الزمن الذي تكتمل عنده 95% من الطلبات، وهو المقياس الأصدق لتجربة المستخدم الفعلية تحت الضغط.

# الفصل الأول: لماذا تنهار النماذج التجريبية عند أول مستخدم حقيقي؟

في الساعة التاسعة صباحاً أطلق الفريق مساعده الذكي لخدمة العملاء. بحلول الظهيرة كان النظام قد أصدر ثلاثين استرداداً مالياً مخالفاً للسياسة، واستدعى واجهة الشحن أربع عشرة مرة لنفس الطلب. ماذا حدث؟ العرض التجريبي عمل بالأمس دون خطأ واحد!

السر يكمن في رياضيات الاحتمالات المركبة[^1]. حين تنجح كل خطوة منفردة بنسبة 92%، يظن المطور المبتدئ أن نظامه ممتاز. لكن ربط 6 خطوات متتالية يخفض احتمال نجاح الرحلة الكاملة إلى 60.6% فقط، وفق المعادلة الصريحة $P = 0.92^6 = 0.606$.

> قاعدة أساسية: موثوقية 92% في الخطوة الواحدة تهبط عبر 6 خطوات متتالية إلى 60.6% فقط عند غياب بوابات التحقق.

# الفصل الثاني: فصل التخطيط عن التنفيذ الحتمي

لا تطلب من النموذج اللغوي أن يحسب عرض كعب كتاب أو رصيد حساب بنكي. اطلب منه فقط استخراج المعطيات وتحديد نية المستخدم، ثم اترك الرياضيات للكود الصرف.

هذا المبدأ البسيط يختصر نصف أعطال الإنتاج دفعة واحدة. النموذج اللغوي بارع في التعامل مع الغموض اللغوي وتلخيص النصوص غير المهيكلة، لكنه بطبيعته الإحصائية يولّد الرموز الأكثر ترجيحاً لا النتائج الحتمية.

## نموذج عقد الأداة الصارم

لكي تمنع الوكيل من تمرير معاملات ناقصة أو أنواع بيانات خاطئة، عرّف لكل أداة عقداً برمجياً واضحاً يتحقق من القيم قبل التنفيذ الفعلي:

```python
from dataclasses import dataclass

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RefundCommand:
    order_id: str
    amount_cents: int
    idempotency_key: str

    def validate(self) -> None:
        if self.amount_cents <= 0 or self.amount_cents > 50_000:
            raise ValueError("Amount outside autonomous policy bounds")
        if not self.order_id.startswith("ORD-"):
            raise ValueError("Malformed order identifier")
```

لاحظ ما أنجزناه في بضعة أسطر برمجية قصيرة: حتى لو أخطأ النموذج تحت ضغط سياق طويل واقترح مبلغاً يتجاوز سقف الصلاحية التلقائية (`50000` قرش)، ترفض الدالة التنفيذ فوراً وتعيد رسالة خطأ واضحة توجه المسار نحو المراجعة البشرية.

# Glossary

- **Backpressure:** Signaling upstream senders to slow down or shed load when downstream consumers reach capacity.
- **Bulkhead:** Partitioned thread, memory, or connection pools isolating one dependency's failure from unrelated paths.
- **Idempotency Key:** Client-generated unique token guaranteeing that repeated attempts execute a side effect at most once.
- **Retry Budget:** Ratio limit (`10%`) bounding total retry traffic across an entire process.

# Chapter 1: Retries Are Amplifiers in Disguise

A thirty-second database hiccup should cause thirty seconds of errors. Instead, it took the payment platform offline for four hours. Nobody pushed bad code that afternoon. Three well-meaning retry loops did the wrecking all by themselves.

Here is the arithmetic most teams miss until it hurts[^1]. Suppose an API gateway retries failed calls 3 times, the order service retries 3 times, and the ledger client retries 3 times. Each layer turns 1 request into 4 attempts. Across 3 stacked tiers, a single user click explodes into $4^3 = 64$ database queries right when the database is already gasping for CPU.

> Field rule: Three stacked tiers each configured with 3 retries multiply downstream pressure up to 64 times during a slowdown.

## Token-Bucket Retry Budgets

Stop configuring retries per request in isolation. Enforce a process-wide retry budget instead:

1. Credit a local token bucket with 0.1 tokens for every normal request sent.
2. Spend 1.0 token whenever a call needs a retry.
3. If the bucket hits zero, fail fast without retrying!

During healthy traffic, rare packet drops retry immediately because the bucket stays full. During a real outage, retries cap themselves at 10% overhead and stop hammering the recovering server.

# Chapter 2: Queues Never Create Capacity

Engineers love putting queues in front of slow services. It feels tidy. Spikes go in, smooth work comes out.

Except a queue never manufactures a single CPU cycle. It only borrows time from impatient callers. When arrival rate exceeds service rate for more than a few seconds, an unbounded in-memory queue grows until every item reaching the worker has already timed out at the browser! You end up burning 100% of your database capacity computing answers for users who already left.

## Propagate Deadlines End-to-End

Pass an explicit deadline header on every internal RPC and check remaining budget before starting expensive work:

```python
import time

def handle_checkout(request_deadline_ms: int) -> dict:
    remaining_ms = request_deadline_ms - int(time.time() * 1000)
    if remaining_ms < 45:
        raise TimeoutError("Caller deadline expired; shedding stale request")
    return {"status": "accepted", "budget_ms": remaining_ms}
```

Combined with a small bounded queue (`max_depth = 128`), deadline propagation drops stale requests in microseconds and preserves full throughput for live customers.

# Chapter 3: Bulkheads and Graceful Fallbacks

Shipbuilders stopped building single-hull vessels centuries ago. One hull breach flooded the entire ship. Yet many microservices still share a single HTTP client pool across critical checkout calls and optional "customers also viewed" widgets.

When the recommendation cache stalls for 2000 ms, its slow responses occupy every worker thread in the shared pool. Within seconds, checkout fails too—even though payment processing is completely healthy.

> Benchmark result: Capping retries at 10% and isolating pools kept checkout success at 99.4% while the recommendation cache was offline.

## Comparing Failure Containment Strategies

| Strategy | Implementation Cost | Blast Radius Reduction | Typical Latency Overhead |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Shared Pool (None) | Minimal | 0% (total contagion) | 0 ms until saturation |
| Per-Dependency Pool | Low (config only) | High (thread isolation) | < 1 ms |
| Static Cache Fallback | Medium | Very High (graceful UI) | 2 ms cache lookup |
| Circuit Breaker + Shed | Medium | Extreme (protects DB) | < 1 ms counter check |

Partitioning thread and connection pools by dependency criticality costs twenty lines of configuration. In our load benchmark, pairing isolated pools with a 10% retry cap kept primary checkout success at 99.4% even while the recommendation tier failed completely.

## Pre-Release Resilience Checklist

Before promoting any critical service to production traffic, confirm four invariants:

- Every outbound network client sets an explicit connect and read timeout.
- Every mutating endpoint accepts an idempotency key and deduplicates replays.
- Queue sizes are strictly bounded and reject overflow with `HTTP 429` or `503`.
- Automated pre-release tests exercise at least one dependency timeout path.
